question: What exact XOR-affine structure do the 16 D179 member classes have?
number: All 16 classes have 32768 members, XOR rank 15, and the same 17 dual parity masks; only the coset representative changes
notes: Exact generator property and proof-relevant reduction: a future class-invariance proof only needs the 15 independent XOR toggles plus composable witness maps. This does not prove alive(E,y) invariance.
